notes.title: 1.2 update
notes.content:
- Added new material item > [b]Beer Crate[/b]
- You can open beer crate in-game to earn some rewards
- Added new currency > Crystals
- Instead of gold, you now should use crystals to purchase skins/backgrounds
- you can exchange gold to crystals in upgrade menu
- added 2 new skins and 2 new backgrounds
- added new background theme to the game. Music author was credited in the about us section

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
New update released - 1.1

change log:

- Removed shaking animation when level up
  > The color animation was not touched.
- Added new skin "KVASS"
- Fixed names of skins that drop for playtime in skin selector
- Increased amount of gold you get for exchanging Empty Bottle
  > Before it was 50 gold, and now it is 1000 gold.
